'''Goldleaf trees''' were a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Plagen]]. Members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chikarri]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet lived in compact apartments built in goldleaf trees in the world's plateau communities.<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Goldleaf trees were first mentioned in the "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" section of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[November]] [[1996]].<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />
